How much money do you really need to retire? Is ₹5 crore enough, or do you actually need ₹20 crore or more? In this video, Karthik Rangappa uses a simple thought experiment to explain why retirement numbers often feel unbelievable and how inflation, returns, lifestyle, and time shape your retirement corpus. Instead of relying on predictions, he looks at the past to help you better understand what the future could realistically look like, making retirement planning far more relatable and practical.
